Name: Chariot du Nord as Sophia
Author: TaniaHylian
Description: You'll need to have SMAPI, Content Patcher and Stardew Valley Expanded﻿ for this mod to work, but on it's own it's very easy to install. Just paste the downloaded carpet into your mods folder and you're done!

Downloads.Description: Replaces some in-game outfits for LWA-inspired ones, like Shiny Chariot's dress and hat, Luna Nova's hats (3 different colors), and Luna Nova's uniform (3 different colors).

Manifest.Name: LWA clothes
Manifest.Description: Replaces some shirts and hats with clothes from Little Witch Academia.
Manifest.Author: TaniaHylian

Downloads.Description: Turns Sophia from Stardew Valley Expanded into Chariot du Nord from Little Witch Academia; changes the portraits, in-game model and name of the character. Optional files replace some outfits and hats for LWA-inspired ones, like Shiny-Chariot's outfit.
